paragraphs.source_en: The next day, the first blast of the horn startled all three daughters awake. When they rose and looked out, shouts of men and neighing horses filled the castle and its grounds. Their mother stood before the gallery of the three-story palace, staring fixedly at the troops marching to war. Sixty-two-year-old Katsuie sat vigorous and erect upon his horse, shading his eyes with one hand as he gazed up at the roof of the nine-story keep. What could have stirred the old warrior so deeply?

units.source_en: Thus, on the seventeenth day of the third month, when Hideyoshi's main army reached Kinomoto, reports concerning the northern army streamed in from Shōmyōji and elsewhere.

units.source_en: Hideyoshi had long expected Uesugi Kagekatsu of Echigo to act in concert with him, and as soon as he reached Kinomoto, he confidently wrote to Suda Mitsuchika, commander of Matsukura in Etchū.
units.source_zh: 秀吉早就料到越后的上杉景胜会和自己呼应，刚一抵达木本，就满怀自信地给越中松仓的守将须田满亲写了一封书函。

paragraphs.source_zh: 因此，三月十七，当秀吉的大队人马抵达木本，北军的一些军情源源不断地从称名寺及其他地方传来。秀吉早就料到越后的上杉景胜会和自己呼应，刚一抵达木本，就满怀自信地给越中松仓的守将须田满亲写了一封书函。

paragraphs.source_en: “It would seem there is no need for your side to raise troops in support”—a deft stroke: this was Hideyoshi's strategy. Put that way, the Uesugi could hardly refrain from taking the field even if they had wished to.

units.source_en: “It would seem there is no need for your side to raise troops in support”—a deft stroke: this was Hideyoshi's strategy.

units.source_en: Put that way, the Uesugi could hardly refrain from taking the field even if they had wished to.
units.source_zh: 这么一说，即使上杉氏不想发兵，恐也不能了。

paragraphs.source_en: Yet once he returned to the main camp at Kinomoto, Hideyoshi immediately turned grave, and his entire manner changed abruptly. He hurriedly summoned his younger brother Hashiba Hidenaga, along with Hosokawa Tadaoki, Hachisuka Hikoemon Masakatsu, and Kuroda Kanbei Yoshitaka, who knew the local terrain, into the command tent.

units.source_en: Yet once he returned to the main camp at Kinomoto, Hideyoshi immediately turned grave, and his entire manner changed abruptly.
units.source_zh: 可是，一旦撤回木本的大营，秀吉就会立刻变得严肃，所有的举动都会来个大转弯。
